answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the umber of a task receipt, and the garden is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the horizon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
